search.objective: Test whether the 11-12 diode cluster is set by GRT_ANTENNA_ITERS, and what lowering it does to the final antenna count; signoff-clean before any area comparison
search.reference: aes-coupling-20261005-hul-h15-both (6 antenna, 0 fanout/slew/cap, area 145844 um2, 39 nets with 8+ diodes holding 37% of 1116)

candidates._why: One axis from aes-coupling-20261005-hul-h15-both: GRT_ANTENNA_ITERS 10 -> 5. In the archived final netlists of c0 and hul, 35 of the 36 nets with 8+ antenna diodes (39 nets, 37-41% of all diodes, 11-12 each) have exactly one real sink (mux2 A1/A0, dfxtp D, and2 B), and no net with 8+ diodes has more than 3 sinks, so the count is not one diode per sink pin. 11-12 equals ITERS (10) plus one. Prediction if one diode is added per round on a pin that stays violated: the cluster moves to about 5+1 diodes and slew, capacitance and fanout failures on those nets shrink. Prediction against it: the cluster stays at 11-12 or the final antenna count rises well above hul's 6. Counter-evidence already in the archive: aes-coupling-20261005-orig-10ns-075-fo10 ran with the same GRT_ANTENNA_ITERS 10 and MARGIN 50 and has no 11-12 cluster (at most 9 diodes, 11 nets with 8+), so ITERS is at most necessary, not sufficient; a cluster that does not move with ITERS here would remove it as a lever.
